$comment: The seats every install gets: only these <harness>-<role> providers, plus every seat the model table names and the seats this machine added (setup.json), are written into Paseo and have a runtime. Harnesses: claude, codex, pi, opencode. Roles: hq, supervisor, lead, peer, lens. Any harness can hold any role.
$comment_restrictModels: true: each provider lists only the models room/models.json assigns to it (read from the harness's live catalog when the room is set up). false: the harness's full model list.
